earlier_scan.note: Extinct; Glottolog notes only ~40 words on record (Hsiu 2014/2023 comments); no phonological description exists

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3. Languoid yang1310 'Yangchun Pai Yao' and its reference records 663009 (Hsiu 2023) and 320668 (Hsiu 2014, 'Mondzish: a new subgroup of Lolo-Burmese', IsCLL-14, 62-81).
sources.note: No descriptive references at all. Comment: 'Although only some 40 words worth of data are on record, it is arguable (Andrew Hsiu 2023) that Yangchun Pai Yao must have been a different language from its closest relative (Dzao Min [bpn]).' Hsiu 2014 is only the AES endangerment-status source and concerns Lolo-Burmese, not this language.

sources.citation: Hsiu, Andrew. 2023. The Pai Yao language of Yangchun: final remnants of a Mienic language. Abstract, SEALS 32 (Chiang Mai University, 16-18 May 2023), abstracts book p. 28.
sources.note: Nothing on stress, tone or prosody. Reports ~40 lexical items elicited on 4 Aug 2019 from the sole rememberer (Yang Heying, 82, Mai clan, Shiqi hamlet), matching the brief character wordlist in the 1996 Yangchun County Gazetteer; argues Yangchun Pai Yao is a distinct Mienic language closest to Zao Min. The only phonetic transcription in the abstract is a place name [sak55 ki21].

sources.citation: 阳春方言 [Yangchun dialects]. 2010. Sina blog post (cited by zh.wikipedia 藻敏方言); the Internet Archive 2020-05-15.
sources.note: Section 三、阳春瑶语 gives about ten Tiedong Mai-clan words in Chinese characters ('嘴叫"池堆"，鼻叫"皮镜"，血叫"潜"，吃猪肉叫"愿洞柜"，妻子叫"坳"，姑娘叫"勉地"，头叫"卜改"，眼叫"嘎叮"，父亲叫"过"，母亲叫"娜"'), evidently the gazetteer list; character transcription carries no tone or stress information.

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en). 'Yangchun Pai Yao language'; Wikipedia (zh) 阳春排瑶语 and 藻敏方言; Wikipedia (en) 'Dzao Min language' and 'Mienic languages' (raw wikitext).
sources.note: Stubs: the 1996 Yangchun County Gazetteer 'has just over a dozen Yangchun Pai Yao words that were transcribed in Chinese characters' and reported 13 semi-speakers; Hsiu 2023 found one rememberer in 2019. zh 藻敏方言: '永宁镇铁垌瑶族村有些麦姓老年藻敏语使用者（在当地称作排瑶）'. No phonology, tone or stress information anywhere.
